content.text: Skip to main navigationSkip to contentSkip to footerEnter nowWin 2 tickets for the Champions League home match against Real MadridRead article contentsIncrease sizeDear FC Bayern-Fans, Champions League showdown in Munich! In the quarter-final of the Champions League, FC Bayern will host Real Madrid for the second leg at the Allianz Arena. Secure your chance now to win 2 tickets for the second leg and experience live how FC Bayern fights for a place in the Champions League semi-finals. Enter the raffle by April 12—don’t miss out!
